_description: qutebrowser bookmarks — FOLDER source of truth for the dashboard start page (List + Icons views) AND flattened `Folder/name` quickmarks. Cloud folders are DATA-DRIVEN: the generator (src/dashboard/gen-dashboard.sh) derives them from cloud-data's build-flakes_desktop.json (each service's proxy.primary.wg_only splits public vs WG-only; .domain / .dns give the URL). Services + Local are hand-curated here. Edit this file or the cloud service build.jsons; never edit the generated dashboard.html. Folder order = array order.
